title: Adjunction-unit inverse image of a pro-etale module section
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the canonical inverse and direct images and their adjunction [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $M$ a sheaf of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For a site object $V\to Y$ and a section $s\in M(V)$, define its inverse-image unit section $f^{-1}s\in(f^{-1}M)(X\times_Y V)$ by evaluating the adjunction unit $\eta_{f,M}:M\to f_*f^{-1}M$ at $V$ and applying it to $s$. Here $f^{-1}M$ is the canonical module inverse image over $f^{-1}R$, and $(f_*N)(V)=N(X\times_Y V)$. If a small model is used to construct the module adjunction, transport the section back to these original site objects; no additional choice of section or comparison is made.
